title: Cross-disease case-control transcriptome resource: analysis code and data deposit (release v1.0)
description:
Analysis code and the eleven-folder data deposit of a cross-disease case-control transcriptome resource: 26 public case-control cohorts across 10 disease contexts, 17 frozen signalling modules (99 genes) and 442 cohort-module pairs, scored in three separate layers (bulk GSVA z-scores, TCGA member-mean z-scores, single-cell member means) with coverage-aware standardised effect sizes (SMDH, SMCRPH), REML pooling with Hartung-Knapp inference, and a validation ledger that separates PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL and NOT TESTED.

Contents: deposit/ (data, quality-control records, reuse examples, environment and the archived pipeline), the maintained Python and R implementations under src/, R/, scripts/ and tests/, printed reference tables under data/reference/, and the integrity manifests deposit/08_qc/file_inventory_and_checksums.csv and deposit/08_qc/checksums_sha256.txt.
